name: Family-Photo Grouping Workbook
description: Enter names once. Check your chosen family-photo groups. Print a list your photographer can call by name. A macro-free .xlsx planning workbook for couples organizing wedding family photos, with a reusable roster, private pair checks, a separate day-of list, a fictional example, blank A4 and US Letter PDFs, and a setup guide. Up to 60 people, 30 chosen pairs and 40 groups of ten people. Tested in LibreOffice desktop; Google Sheets support is not verified or claimed. Pair flags are advisory; no automatic scheduling or family decisions.
image_alt: Cover for the Family-Photo Grouping Workbook: enter names once, check your groups, and print your list.

name: Youth Sports Team-Parent Kit
description: A parent or coach who just got asked to run snacks, sideline duties and the roster can put the season in one offline file. Add the families and the schedule, then build a fair rotation. Print the binder pages, or send a plain text list. Households take one turn, even when two siblings are on the team.
image_alt: Cover for the Youth Sports Team-Parent Kit, showing a filled snack and duty rotation from a fictional winter basketball example.

name: School-Week Visual Routine Kit
description: A parent of one, two or three school-age kids can set the daily picture-and-word steps, then fill a board for this week: drop-off, pickup, after-school plans, and what to pack each day. Print the charts, the cut-out cards and the weekly board. No account is needed.
image_alt: Cover for the School-Week Visual Routine Kit, showing a this-week board for drop-off, pickup, after-school plans and what to bring each day.

name: Leftover-First Weekly Meal Planner
description: A household cook can paste or enter usual dinners, list what is already in the fridge or pantry, and fill a week leftover-first: a cook-once dinner feeds a planned leftover night or lunch, and what is on hand is used before new ingredients. The planner then builds one grocery list, grouped by store section, that subtracts what is already on hand. Print the plan and the list. No account is needed.
image_alt: Cover for the Leftover-First Weekly Meal Planner, showing a week filled leftover-first with lunch and dinner slots.

name: Two-Parent Christmas Gift Tracker
description: When two adults split the Christmas shopping, it's easy to lose track of who bought what, and to end up with one child getting more than the others. This workbook keeps one shared list, shows each child's gift count and spending side by side, and flags online orders that might miss the gift date or a return window.

name: Cookie Box Planner
description: Paste your own recipes, set how many boxes you're giving and what goes in each, and the planner does the rest. It works out how many whole batches to make, builds a dated plan for mixing, freezing, thawing and baking that counts back from your giving day, and gives you one combined shopping list in store pack sizes.

name: Holiday Bundle
description: Two planners for the busy part of December. The gift tracker keeps one shared gift list for two adults and shows each child's gift count and spending side by side. The cookie box planner takes your own recipes and works out the batches, a dated bake-and-freeze plan and one shopping list.
image_alt: Cover for the Holiday Bundle: the Two-Parent Christmas Gift Tracker and the Cookie Box Planner, two digital downloads in one zip.

name: Christmas Morning Gift Hunt
description: Each kid gets their own colour, their own trail and clues they can read. Tick the hiding spots you really have, and the builder gives every kid a separate trail, so nobody races a sibling to the same spot. Then print the clue cards, a parent hide sheet and an answer key.
image_alt: Cover for the Christmas Morning Gift Hunt, showing red, green, gold and blue clue cards for a picture clue, a rhyme, a riddle and a secret letter-shift code.

name: Holiday Thank-You Kit
description: In December there can be ten or more people to thank besides family: class teachers, aides, the bus driver, coaches, daycare staff, the sitter, the mail carrier. Type their names once. The kit gives each person a give-by date, shows who is overdue, and prints matching gift card holders and tags with their name on them.
image_alt: Cover for the Holiday Thank-You Kit, showing name-printed gift card holders that say To, a thank-you line and From.
